name: FairytaleQA
summary: 10,580 questions written by education experts about 278 children's stories, covering seven narrative elements, for reading comprehension from kindergarten to eighth grade.

license.note: A software license applied to data; the stories come from Project Gutenberg.

cite: Xu, Y., Wang, D., Yu, M., Ritchie, D., Yao, B., Wu, T., et al. (2022). Fantastic Questions and Where to Find Them: FairytaleQA, an Authentic Dataset for Narrative Comprehension. ACL 2022. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2022.acl-long.34

fits.how: A story's passage and an educator's question become test cases for a reading tutor.

connect.note: A passage from a children's story and an educator's question about it: does a reading tutor send the learner back to the text, catch a wrong answer, confirm a right one? The stories are old and from Project Gutenberg, so they may not suit your learners. It shows what your judge read, not what learners learn.
